scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:passwords && npm run db:migrate:reads && npx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --env staging --file worker/migrations/20260928_password_auth.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --env staging --file worker/migrations/20260930_read_indexes.sql && npx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:d1: npx wrangler d1 execute aquasight --file=worker/schema.sql --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:passwords: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --env production --file worker/migrations/20260928_password_auth.sql
scripts.db:migrate:reads: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --env production --file worker/migrations/20260930_read_indexes.sql
